brief: Sales kick-off in or near Munich for 120 people, 1 night, arriving 2027-01-20. We need a plenary room plus 4 breakout rooms for the regional sessions. Budget EUR 70,000 all in.

input.query: Munich conference hotel plenary breakout rooms sales kick-off

input.summary: Three Munich-area venues are open on 2027-01-20 and priced within the EUR 70,000 budget, all including an estimated EUR 18,000 group train travel from Berlin. All three need budget-owner sign-off because they are over EUR 20,000. Alte Maelzerei is the cheapest, and Isarforum has the most room to grow.

offers.tradeOff: Lowest price with hotel next door and 5 breakouts; the 150-seat hall is the smallest margin and the vibe is lively rather than formal.
policyNotes: Expert review before any vendor contact

offers.tradeOff: Purpose-built for sales kick-offs with a 250-seat plenary and 8 breakouts; costs about EUR 2,760 more than Maelzerei.
policyNotes: Expert review before any vendor contact

offers.tradeOff: Mountain-view setting with exactly 4 breakouts; most expensive, farthest from Berlin by train (about 5 h) and outside Munich in Tegernheim.
policyNotes: Expert review before any vendor contact

rfp.subject: RFP: Sales kick-off, 120 guests, arrival 2027-01-20, 1 night
rfp.body:
Hello,

Demo Co. is planning a sales kick-off and would like a proposal for:
- Arrival 2027-01-20, 1 night (departure 2027-01-21)
- 120 guests, 120 single-occupancy room nights
- One plenary room for 120 people plus 4 breakout rooms for regional sessions
- Day delegate package (meeting room, lunch, coffee) for both days
- Dietary needs: none specified yet; please confirm vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options
- Accessibility: no wheelchair users currently; step-free access preferred
- Budget guide: EUR 70,000 all in, including group travel from Berlin

Please send availability, a full price breakdown and terms by 2026-10-25.

Thank you,
Demo Co. Events
